summary: This Docker Compose configuration mounts the SSH credentials from your local machine into a container so that the app service can authenticate using your SSH keys. The ${HOME} variable expands to your user's home directory, making the config portable across different machines.

explanations.7: The dash creates a list item; the part before the colon is the path on your actual computer (your SSH folder), and the part after is where it appears inside the container (at /christophe/.ssh). The ${HOME} variable gets replaced with your actual home directory path when Docker runs this.
